description: Searches all tools of the AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank (KULIC Advisory) by task, keyword or tool name, in German or English, and returns the best matches with name, purpose and input fields. This endpoint lists only a core set; use find_tool when no listed tool fits, then call the match with run_tool (or directly by name if your client allows it). Open without sign-in, stores nothing.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. 'supplier changed bank account', 'Skonto', 'SLA', 'compare offers'.

name: find_tool
title: Find the right AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank tool for a task
